reference: The 76.89655% designated-validation delivery is f214f8b33b7066fb4c670379fc6bbb4920553dab. Existing seed_policy and seed_completion hold its five sealed anonymous train-only runs. The new investigation never opens release, designated labels, formal test or H2 while selecting.
question: The successful field-aligned tree retains one related field per context. Can estimates shared across several comparable fields or a separately regularized profile-by-context learner add information to the current autonomous incumbent?

candidates.posterior: Preserve the recurring-tree backbone and previously cross-fitted categorical aligned values. Fit smoothed context-by-field-value response maps for every field in a discovered shared-vocabulary family. Pool their effects with weights from conditional information, soften more in smaller groups, and expose the weighted response, between-field spread and effective support. Held training features are generated without their entire exact-feature group. One depth-six 600-iteration CatBoost per fit with otherwise unchanged settings.
candidates.crossed: Fit one L2-regularized sparse logistic model on categorical main effects, repeated-profile and context intercepts, interactions of varying fields with other individual attributes, and repeated-profile deviations for each varying field. Give small-group interactions stronger shrinkage by fixed scales. All names, repeated blocks, viable field pairs and feature vocabularies are data-derived. No lookup of dataset identity, specific field names, or category meanings.

feedback: For each of five old full-training outer folds, exclude the original primary and two confirmation held-group partitions. Divide the remaining groups into two comparable panels by seeded stratified group split (seed 87241). On each panel recreate the actually exported incumbent recipe, including the original decision about three-seed averaging and preserving frozen members. Fit the two additional candidates using only its complementary fitting data. Nominate on panel one from retain or .125/.25/.5/1 candidate shares by primary accuracy, then Brier loss, then lower share. Either keep or reject this exact nominee on panel two. Accept only if both panels are nonnegative, pooled accuracy increases at least .002 and their pooled binary Brier loss does not increase. Panels score no overlapping groups; examples can be used when fitting the other panel. No new LLM. Seeded replicas, frozen-context fits and all challenger classifier fits are included in per-path accounting with ceiling 64; unsupervised vocabulary and internal empirical table counts reported separately.
outer: Refit both challengers on all outer training rows for predeclared diagnostics, independent of the inner winner. Primary is the policy assigned without the outer labels. Compare to exactly the frozen autonomous prediction on the same rows with one vote per original training row. Fixed-quarter mixtures and candidate-alone are descriptive. Seal and independently reload all proposed exports before evaluating. Reused experimental outer folds are developmental. Qualify a fresh matched unified-entry comparison only if policy pooled gain >=.003, >=3 positive folds and worst fold >=-.003. A fresh comparison, never the historical screen alone, would qualify a designated check with >=.003 pooled, >=2 of 3 positive, worst fold >=-.003. Keep the incumbent if a method is inapplicable.
